summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a September 8, 2026 securities purchase agreement and same-day closing of a $8.0 million private placement of 20,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at $0.40 per share to certain non-U.S. investors. Purchase price payable in USD, USDT, USDC or a combination. Post-closing, 28,542,617 Class B shares outstanding. Sold offshore under Regulation S; shares unregistered. Proceeds earmarked for digital asset reserve, working capital and general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or advisor named; no premium, close date or break fee stated. Watch for dilution and digital-asset treasury strategy execution.
